languageResources: Preserves fixed language-resource commit, five published dictionaries, published section messages and published DeepLX endpointHelp; current section and DeepLX copy are registered through uiLanguageBundles, while document.config and other extension-only reader copy are excluded from all seven userscript projections.
assertions: Assertion and isolated VM bodies from const preludeStartMarker onward are byte-identical to both merge parents; only provenance comments and the measured size threshold changed.
measurementLimit: Delta is measured for the complete minified artifact; incrementScope identifies shared consumers rather than claiming additive per-module byte attribution.
